jobs.occupation: Defence Business Development Lead, Space Inventor
jobs.description:
Space Inventor is looking for an experienced Defence Business Development Lead to drive business development, collaboration and sales within the defence and security market.

The Defence Business Development Lead will be responsible for identifying, developing and closing opportunities with defence customers, government organisations, procurement agencies, defence primes and strategic industry partners across Europe and internationally, with a focus on European, Nordic and Baltic regions.

The role will focus on satellite missions, constellations and space-based capabilities supporting areas such as ISR, SIGINT, Earth observation, maritime surveillance, situational awareness, secure communications and sovereign space capabilities.

This is a senior hands-on government- and customer-facing role. You will own opportunities from early market engagement and requirement shaping through RFI/RFP, proposal development, negotiation and contract award. As the business development lead, you will be supported by a cross-functional team of specialists that will help shape competitive and technically sound proposals.

A key part of the role is to engage with partners/primes and government officials before formal procurements are released. You will use your existing defence network and market understanding to identify emerging requirements, programmes and partnerships where Space Inventor's satellite capabilities can create operational value.

You do not need to be a satellite engineer, but you must have a solid understanding of the sales cycle and the ability to navigate complex sales processes. Additionally, you must be able to understand complex operational requirements and engage credibly with military, governmental, commercial and technical stakeholders.

The job is located in Aalborg or Copenhagen, Denmark. You’ll report to the Mission Sales Director and work closely with both the marketing and sales teams.

Your Responsibilities

• Lead commercial negotiations covering scope, pricing, contractual conditions and programme requirements.

• Develop and grow Space Inventor's business within the European and international defence and security market, with focus on Nordics and Baltics.

• Identify and develop opportunities through an established network across Ministries of Defence, armed forces, procurement agencies, defence primes, system integrators and strategic partners.

• Engage customers early to understand operational requirements, upcoming programmes and procurement plans before formal tenders are released.

• Own the commercial sales cycle from qualification through RFI/RFQ/RFP, proposal, negotiation and contract award.

• Develop strategic accounts and capture plans for priority defence programmes and customers.

• Identify and qualify local partners in the focus countries and build partnerships/consortia to address local needs and requirements.

• Monitor defence programmes, budgets, tenders, competitors and market developments to identify future opportunities.

• Maintain the defence sales pipeline, forecasts and opportunity strategies and contribute to Space Inventor's overall defence market strategy.

• Represent Space Inventor at customer meetings, exhibitions and industry events.

Qualifications

You should have strong knowledge of the defence sector, its operational environment and customer landscape, combined with a good understanding of space-based defence capabilities and their role in modern defence operations.

You do not need to be a technical space specialist, but you should be able to understand defence requirements, identify where satellite-based solutions can provide operational value and engage credibly with defence customers and Space Inventor's technical specialists.

We expect you to have:

• Significant proven experience within defence sales, business development, capture management, partnership development and complex defence solution sales.

• A successful track record of developing business with defence and governmental customers, including signed contracts and long-term strategic partnerships

• A strong and relevant existing network within the European defence industry, including relationships with defence organisations, procurement agencies, primes, system integrators and strategic partners.

• A strong international outlook and preferably an established global defence network.

• Experience engaging directly with Ministries of Defence, armed forces, defence procurement organisations or other governmental stakeholders.

• Strong understanding of B2G sales and defence procurement processes.

• Ability to understand technically complex products and communicate their operational and commercial value.

• Strong stakeholder management, communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

• Professional fluency in English.

• Willingness to travel frequently within Europe and internationally.

• Ability to work closely with engineers and technical specialists when developing customer solutions.

Advantageous experience:

• Previous experience within space, satellites, ISR, SIGINT, electronic warfare, surveillance, secure communications, sensors, UAVs or other advanced defence technologies.

• Previous employment with a defence prime, defence technology company, military organisation, government organisation or procurement authority.

• Experience working with NATO nations or NATO organisations.

• Knowledge of European defence initiatives, funding programmes and procurement mechanisms.

• Military or governmental defence experience.

• Experience working with classified or security-sensitive programmes.

What We Offer

• A full-time role with exposure to a variety of disciplines within space technology.

• A position in an exciting, rapidly growing industry with significant international reach.

• A chance to shape your role and responsibilities within a growing company.

• Great colleagues and several social events each year.

• Health insurance and additional employee benefits.

• Competitive salary and good working conditions.

How to Apply

If you’re ready to take your career to the next level, apply by submitting your CV and application. If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact us via jobs@space-inventor.com, and we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

Interviews are held continuously until the right candidate is found.

Start date to be agreed, but preferably with start-up as soon as possible.

We look forward to receiving your application.

About Space Inventor

Space Inventor is a leading Satellite company with a passion for exploring space and delivering innovative solutions in satellite technology. Our mission is to revolutionize the space industry with creativity, technical expertise, and reliability. With our 250+ years of combined experience in the space industry, we are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what satellites can achieve.

Are you a self-driven, ambitious sales professional who is always looking for new business opportunities and ways to make a difference for your customers?

• Do you want to become part of our Nordic Industrial Solutions team, where technical expertise, entrepreneurship, and close customer partnerships are at the heart of everything we do?

If so, this position at Alsiano might be the perfect match for you!

About Alsiano

For more than 65 years, Alsiano has partnered with leading international manufacturers of raw materials and additives. We specialize in raw materials and additives for industrial applications such as plastics and elastomers, paints and coatings, industrial and institutional (I&I) cleaning products, household cleaning products, food, and healthcare.

The Role

You will be responsible for your customer portfolio in Denmark and Southern Sweden, where you will offer plastic raw materials and additives. Your focus will be on growing your existing customer base while identifying new customers and business opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct customer visits to identify potential and explore new business opportunities, prepare offers, negotiate prices, and follow up on projects and sales pipelines.

• Deliver technical product presentations and solution recommendations during customer meetings.

• Participate in relevant webinars, exhibitions, seminars, and other customer-related events.

• Proactively plan and manage your sales activities in a structured manner.

• Collaborate closely with key suppliers and identify opportunities for new supplier partnerships by recognizing market trends and customer needs.

You will independently drive the entire sales process, from building and managing your pipeline to arranging meetings and preparing offers. A significant portion of your time will involve customer visits and communication via webinars, phone, and other channels.

You will analyze customer needs, objectives, challenges, and opportunities, advising customers on how Alsiano's solutions can positively impact their products and business. In close collaboration with suppliers and colleagues, you will develop tailored solutions and successfully convert opportunities into sales.

Who You Are

To succeed in this role, we expect you to have at least 3-5 years’ experience in technical B2B sales, combined with a relevant technical education. It is essential that you can effectively engage with customers, work independently, and bring a high level of energy and self-motivation.

You possess excellent negotiation and communication skills in Danish and English and have a good understanding of Swedish. Experience selling plastic raw materials to industrial customers is a distinct advantage.

Furthermore, you are:

• An ambitious and professional trusted advisor who delivers a high level of customer service.

• Able to balance both short-term and long-term objectives and prioritize your efforts accordingly.

• Results-oriented and motivated to achieve ambitious goals.

• Energetic, flexible, outgoing, and systematic in your approach.

• Quality-conscious with a strong attention to detail.

What We Offer

You will be part of a well-functioning Nordic Industrial Solutions team, where you work closely with colleagues across the Nordic region and report directly to the Head of Nordic Sales, Industrial Solutions, based in Gothenburg.

This is a challenging role in a collaborative and supportive environment, where we help each other grow, develop, and create value. We offer a flexible work environment, allowing you to work from Alsiano’s office in Birkerød or from home.

The position involves travel, primarily within Denmark and Southern Sweden, as well as occasional travel to other European countries, approximately 60-80 days per year.

Build and lead Esko’s first global Strategic Accounts sales organization and change how some of the world’s biggest brands buy from us.

**Esko, a Veralto company, is a global provider of software and hardware for packaging design and print workflow, trusted by the brand owners, retailers and converters behind everyday packaged goods. We are hiring a VP, Strategic Account (B2B Software) to move our most important customers from transactional, product-led deals to consultative, value-based partnerships.

You will lead a newly formed and geographically dispersed team of 12 senior level strategic account managers across roughly 90 global tier-1 accounts, with a mandate to deliver significant new ARR alongside renewals. It is a rare chance to put your own stamp on structure, methods and talent, in a fast-evolving technology market leader aiming to scale :200% to $1B annual revenues by 2031.

The role

Based remotely in Europe or the US (50-75% global travel) and reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer, you will build and lead Esko’s global Tier 1 Strategic Account organisation. The VP, Strategic Accounts Sales will own commercial performance across new-customer acquisition, retention, expansion, recurring-revenue growth, profitability, pipeline and forecast accuracy. Each strategic account has a single global commercial owner, and you will lead the people who play that role.

We won’t pretend this brand-new role is straightforward. Esko is undertaking significant growth and transformation, with active M&A, rapid adoption of AI and a shift from on-premise licensing to cloud-based SaaS, and its commercial organisation is still maturing. You will work at pace, through real complexity and some ambiguity. If you find that energising, we would genuinely like to meet you.

What you’ll do

• Own the number. Be accountable for bookings, ARR, new logos, retention, expansion, profitability, pipeline and forecast accuracy across around :90 parent accounts.

• Orchestrate across Esko. Align Presales, Customer Success, Product, Services, Marketing, partners and Esko executives around one plan per account, and bring the customer’s voice into product and go-to-market priorities.

• Open new doors. Expand into new buying centres, business units and regions, and target white space in consumer packaged goods and life sciences.

Who we’re looking for

A global tier 1 strategic accounts sales leader who has sold software/services to the largest companies in an industry, and who has turned that experience into a repeatable system for a team.

• Led global sales teams in a recurring-revenue B2B software & services environment, with measurable ARR growth from acquisition, expansion and retention.

• Built and transformed a strategic account function within a medium or large software organization on a global/multi-regional scale

• Created and embedded modern go-to-market and a consistent strategic-selling process: value selling, MEDDPICC or similar qualification, account planning and documented best practice.

• Designed multi-year strategies for complex multinational customers, led executive-level negotiation and closed complex strategic accounts sales.

• Credible with customer leadership on business strategy and roadmaps.

• Disciplined with CRM (SFDC), forecasting and pipeline management.

• Collaborative, inspiring leader who engages and aligns geographically dispersed, remote-based teams and influences Product, Finance and Customer Experience.

• Flexible to travel globally 50-75%

• Experience in packaging, branding, print technology, pre-media, digital workflow software, life sciences or consumer goods, is useful but not essential

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing or a related field.

Why join

• A genuine transformation mandate. Shape the structure, methods and talent of a commercial organisation that is modernising.

• Scale and ambition. Esko is aiming for $1B in scale by 2031, and the commercial foundation you build will support faster integration of acquisitions. You will gain visibility of M&A as deals progress.

• Room to grow. You report directly to the CRO, with a route to broader commercial leadership over time.

• Executive-level work. Engage the senior leadership of the world’s best-known brands, and help connect their strategy with Esko’s roadmap, services and solutions.

• A long-term home. Esko is part of Veralto, with a long-term horizon rather than a short private-equity exit cycle. Expect real support for people, training, and career development.

**Esko provides software, hardware and services that help brands, retailers, pre-media and trade shops, manufacturers and converters produce better packaging for billions of consumers. Founded in Belgium in 2002 and headquartered in Ghent, Esko touches 90% of the world’s retail packaging, serves over 25,000 customers across 140 countries, with : 1800 associates.

Wake full responsibility for warehouse operations, inventory management and stock accuracy in an international project organisation.

Copenhagen Global A/S is part of Copenhagen Group, a Danish project-driven organisation with a strong international profile. We tender for and manage complex projects for international organisations and national authorities, operating across different markets and in close cooperation with specialised partners.

Our activities place high demands on structured warehouse operations, accurate inventory management and reliable stock control. To support this, we are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Warehouse & Inventory Controller to take full responsibility for Copenhagen Global's warehouse, working closely with colleagues to ensure that all goods, equipment and materials are properly registered, stored and managed.

Your Responsibilities

You will have overall responsibility for the day-to-day operations of Copenhagen Global's warehouse, ensuring accurate stock records and effective inventory control.

Your responsibilities will include registering incoming and outgoing goods, maintaining accurate inventory records and ensuring that all materials and equipment are correctly identified, stored and accounted for. You will be responsible for maintaining and updating the warehouse management system, ensuring that physical stock levels match recorded inventory.

We are looking for someone with previous experience in warehouse management, including direct responsibility for inventory control and goods registration.

You are highly detail-oriented, systematic and reliable, with a strong sense of responsibility and the ability to maintain an overview of a wide range of materials, equipment and ongoing activities.

Practical Information

The position is based at our warehouse facilities in Copenhagen.

Salary will reflect qualifications and experience.

Company Description

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company driving the transition to a sustainable energy system. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years. We employ around 21 000 people mostly in our core markets in Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK.

Job Description

Do you want to make a difference and help industrial companies navigate the energy transition?

Vattenfall’s Business Sales Department offers a wide range of products in the energy field. We operate in a highly competitive and dynamic market, serving large corporate customers, partners, and resellers. Our ambition is to be number one for the customer.

We are looking for a Key Account Manager to join our Industrial Production Clients team within Business Area Customers & Solutions. This is an opportunity to strengthen Vattenfall’s position as the preferred energy partner for industrial customers in Denmark and across the Nordic region.

Our customers operate in an increasingly complex environment where competitiveness, energy supply, commercial risk, and sustainability ambitions are closely connected. In this role, you will help customers navigate these challenges while building long-term partnerships that create value for both the customer and Vattenfall.

Vattenfall has established a strong position within the Industrial Production client segment in Sweden, Finland, and Denmark. As we continue to build an even stronger customer platform in Denmark, you will become an important part of our Nordic sales organization and contribute directly to its future growth.

You will join a Nordic sales team of thirteen Key Account Managers across Sweden, Finland, and Denmark and report to the Sales Manager and Head of Industrial Production Clients Nordic. Based in Copenhagen, you will work closely with colleagues across the region. The team has a collaborative, knowledge-sharing culture, supported by flexible working conditions that combine office collaboration with remote work when appropriate.

Qualifications

Your role

As Key Account Manager, you will be responsible for developing long-term, profitable business and strategic customer partnerships within the Nordic Industrial Production client segment. You will work with prospects and customers to understand their operations, energy needs, market exposure, decision-making structures, and long-term priorities.

From this insight, you will identify opportunities, offer relevant solutions, and negotiate contracts. You will act as a trusted advisor, helping prospects and customers navigate the energy transition, manage market risks, and achieve their sustainability ambitions, including reducing their environmental footprint.

You will coordinate cross-functional expertise across Vattenfall to develop and deliver customer solutions. This includes close cross-functional collaboration to ensure alignment, a seamless customer experience, and long-term value creation.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Develop and manage long-term strategic relationships with industrial prospects & customers in Denmark and across the Nordic market.

• Identify customer needs and translate them into tailored, value-creating energy solutions.

• Take commercial ownership of customer opportunities from early development through internal alignment, negotiation, and contracting.

• Lead commercial discussions and contract negotiations in close collaboration with relevant specialists.

• Coordinate cross-functional bid and solution-development activities, ensuring clear ownership, alignment, and progress.

• Act as a trusted advisor by translating energy-market and industry developments into relevant customer insights.

Manage and develop a profitable customer portfolio while contributing to Vattenfall’s customer offering and commercial platform in Denmark.

Your profile

You are a commercially minded professional with experience in B2B sales, key account management, business development, or another field involving complex customer solutions. Experience from the energy commodity business is highly relevant, while experience from sectors with complex instruments, such as insurance or finance, may also provide a strong foundation.

You combine strategic and commercial focus with operational capability. You are genuinely interested in customers and their industry challenges, and you are motivated to create the best possible value through collaboration. Structured, proactive, and self-driven, you enjoy working independently as well as in a cross-border team.

Your credibility is built through business insight, sound judgement, and clear communication. You are trustworthy, solution-oriented, and comfortable involving the right colleagues to move customer opportunities forward. You bring creative thinking and a drive to continuously develop and improve.

To succeed in this role, you bring:

• A relevant degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Science, or a comparable field.

• Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

• Strong and demonstrated business acumen.

• Experience in B2B sales, key account management, business development, or other complex commercial environments.

• Knowledge of energy commodities, electricity markets, energy procurement, risk management, or comparable complex solutions.

• Strong communication, influencing, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.

• A genuine interest in customers, their operations, and their industry challenges.

• A proactive, collaborative, and solution-oriented way of working.

• Experience with electricity supply agreements, commodity contracts, hedging solutions, power purchase agreements, Nordic electricity markets, or decarbonisation strategies is an advantage.

• An established network within Danish industry or the energy sector would also be beneficial.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Location  Copenhagen

Looking for a career with growth?

Looking for a role where your superpowers can be leveraged to the maximum and with limitless opportunities for growth?

The scale and ambition of our wind, battery and solar business means you can really find your element with us. We’ll also provide you with all the learning and development you need to expand your horizons.

We strive to be the best place to work in the industry with highly competitive pay and conditions and an open, supportive culture. A commitment to a healthy work-life balance aims to ensure everyone plays to their strengths, whatever their background and experiences.

You will be part of a growing team of 1,700+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities where our positive approach to diversity is reflected in the fact that more than a quarter of staff are women.

A helpful, social and diverse workplace with a flat hierarchy and open communication

A healthy work/life balance

55 friendly, driven and skilled colleagues

git

Job Description

Do you want to help shape how a large IT company measures, manages and documents its information security? Are you motivated by turning data, risk and regulation into practical decisions? If so, you may be our next colleague in the newly established GRC team in Netcompany's Group CISO Office.

Responsibilities and technologies

As a member of the GRC team, you will help ensure that Netcompany has an accurate, data-driven view of the effectiveness of its security controls and its level of compliance. The team takes a pragmatic and technically grounded approach to governance, risk and compliance, and works closely with the Application Security team, the Operations organisation, Internal IT and other business functions across the group.

The GRC team is a small team of colleagues with complementary profiles. We do not expect any one candidate to cover every area described below. Instead, we are looking for broad profiles with solid experience across several of these areas and the motivation to develop within the rest.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Developing and maintaining risk scenarios, assessing the effectiveness of mitigating controls against the scenarios, and conducting risk assessments to support business decisions

• Establishing automated measurements and KPIs that provide insight into the implementation and effectiveness of security controls across the business

• Interpreting regulatory and contractual security requirements and translating these into Netcompany's security baselines and standard methodologies

• Planning and executing security awareness activities, including phishing simulations, targeted micro-learning, and onboarding/yearly awareness training

• Driving smaller security improvement projects from planning to implementation, combining coordination with hands-on execution

• Developing, maintaining and testing internal security processes, such as major incident response, crisis management and business continuityDeveloping, maintaining and testing internal security processes, such as major incident response, crisis management and business continuity

About you

You have broad experience within information security and a solid understanding of its technical aspects alongside a general understanding of the software development life cycle. You combine this with the ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical solutions. Furthermore, you are pragmatic, take ownership of your work and prefer a hands-on approach.

To succeed in this role you:

• Hold a relevant degree or equivalent experience; within IT, engineering, computer science or a similar field.

• Strong analytic skills, with the ability to interpret data and draw meaningful conclusions independently.

• Experience within several of the areas listed in the overview of responsibilities in the role.

• Solid communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage effectively with technical teams, business functions, management and, on occasion, customers.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken).

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Partaking alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Send us an application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

As a Specialist, Digital Engagement, you will play a key role in bringing Pandora’s global campaigns to life across digital touchpoints. You will plan, develop, and execute content across web and email, ensuring engaging and high-performing consumer journeys that align with both brand storytelling and commercial priorities.

Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will support campaigns end-to-end - from briefing through to execution - ensuring consistency, quality, and continuous optimisation across channels and markets. You will also contribute to refining customer journeys by leveraging insights, performance data, and user behaviour.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Execute digital campaigns across web and email in line with global brand and commercial strategies

• Translate campaign concepts into engaging, high-performing digital experiences

• Coordinate content across channels and ensure consistency across markets

• Support end-to-end campaign delivery, from briefing to implementation

• Analyse performance data and apply insights to optimise campaigns and customer journeys

• Contribute to continuous improvement of content, placements, and user experience

• Provide guidance and support on local campaign execution

**Your impact

**You will directly influence the quality and effectiveness of Pandora’s digital campaigns and customer journeys across owned channels. Through strong execution and continuous optimisation, you will drive improved engagement, conversion, and brand consistency, while strengthening e-commerce and email performance and enhancing the overall digital customer experience.

**What You’ll Bring

**To succeed in this role, you bring a solid foundation of experience, strong practical skills, and a proactive, hands-on mindset:

**Experience

**

• Approx. 3+ years of experience in digital campaigns, e-commerce, email, or content management

• Experience working within digital marketing, ideally across web and email environments

• Track record of executing digital campaigns and projects

**Skills

**

• Hands-on experience delivering digital-first campaigns in an e-commerce and email

• setup

• Strong understanding of customer journeys and cross-channel execution

• Experience creating engaging digital shopping experiences

• Data-driven mindset with the ability to translate insights into optimisation actions

• Ability to analyse performance data and improve marketing and business KPIs

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• Experience from a global organisation is a plus

**Tools

**

• Proficiency in tools such as Excel, Jira, Figma, and PowerPoint

**Key stakeholders

**You will collaborate closely with a broad range of teams across the business to bring campaigns to life end-to-end. This includes colleagues working with brand and creative development, media and marketing activation, retail, and customer engagement (including email and loyalty).

**Ways of working

**You will operate in a fast-paced, agile environment, balancing execution and optimisation while managing multiple campaigns and stakeholders. The role offers a high degree of ownership, with clear objectives and guidance within established frameworks.

**Additional Information

**Global Career Band: 5B

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. **Do you want to help ensure quality in energy infrastructure projects? Can you turn quality requirements into practical activities and support projects through to handover? And do you have experience with quality management, audits and inspections? Then join COWI as our new Quality Consultant.

****Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

**We are looking for a Quality Consultant to join COWI and support our customers’ construction and operational projects on assignments of both shorter and longer duration. You will help ensure that projects follow the customer’s governance framework and can be handed over to the operations organisation at the required quality level, with all supporting documentation. Your work may span electricity transmission projects, including cables, overhead lines and substations; gas distribution and transmission networks, including natural gas and biogas facilities and stations; oil pipelines; and gas storage facilities.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Support projects in applying internal processes and tools and provide guidance and support on quality-related matters.

• Consistently promote and embed quality management in projects so that documentation, products and deliverables meet the specified requirements

• Plan, carry out and document the necessary quality activities in collaboration with the project team, including internal and external audits and inspections of project partners.

• Ensure that quality-related experience and lessons learned are shared within the customer’s organisation.

• Prepare project quality plans.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways, but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

You work in a structured and systematic way and take a proactive approach to building relationships. You collaborate and communicate on an equal footing with internal and external stakeholders involved in construction projects. You bring professional credibility in your field and can work independently.

On top of that, you will have:

• An understanding of the structure and application of quality management systems.

• Experience with project- and process-related work.

• Experience with quality management activities in infrastructure and construction projects, including quality assurance (QA) and providing input to quality control (QC) activities.

• Experience carrying out quality activities, including audits and inspections of internal and external parties involved in projects.

• Experience using the Microsoft Office suite.

• The ability to communicate in Danish and English, both orally and in writing, at negotiation level.

Your official COWI office location will be either Lyngby, Vejle or Aarhus. However, your primary workplace will be at Energinet in Erritsø, but Ballerup could also be an option, with some travel to Erritsø. You will report to Head of Discipline, Ioana Nicoleta Tuglui, who is based at COWI's headquarters in Lyngby.

**A place to work and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

**Before you apply

**All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Looking for a workplace where you can make real change? A meaningful job where you have the freedom, trust and responsibilities to play an important role and not just be a small fish in a big shoal? Does being a part of a social, passionate, and international team sound right to you? Join us!

Your position

In your new position as a Telecom & Network Engineer in the Telecom Engineering Department, you will join a multicultural, diverse team of skilled, enthusiastic telecommunication specialists from all over the world. As a telecom engineer with a strong network background, you will create, design and develop integrated critical communication systems for the offshore energy industry. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be either at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg, or in Gdynia or Norfolk. The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel from 10-30 days per year depending on which office you will be working at.

“This is an exciting chance to become part of an expanding energy industry, where you can benefit from outstanding career development opportunities. You’ll collaborate with highly skilled and dedicated professionals who are committed to excelling in their field. The role involves working on diverse projects of various scales worldwide, within a collaborative team environment where success is shared” says Head of Engineering, Technology Solutions, Kurt Thorøe.

Your tasks & responsibilities

As a Telecom & Network Engineer, you will design integrated telecom solutions with a strong focus on industrial network technologies. You will take technical responsibility for assigned systems throughout the project lifecycle, from requirements and design through configuration, integration, testing and final documentation Each project is tailored to meet the unique requirements of our clients, providing you with the opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge, customized solutions.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

• Designing and engineering different telecommunication solutions for our clients, which could include network design, CCTV, Line-of-Sight radios and other integrated telecom systems, with a strong focus on network technologies.

• Designing network architecture in accordance with applicable OT security requirements and principles.

• Prepare detail design specification for network to be used for actual implementation.

• Ensuring integration and interface coordination between telecom systems

• Verify configurations and equipment in preparation for Factory Acceptance Tests.

• Performing system configuration, integration and testing as required by the project.

• Following up on subcontractors’ designs, securing technical requirements and interface management.

• Supporting and interacting with subcontractors, customers and other teams across the organisation, such as Telecom Service and the Tender team.

Your profile & qualifications

You are a detail-oriented and structured engineer with a curious and analytical mindset. In addition, you have a proactive and organised approach to your work and thrive in a workday with lots of variation and teamwork.

We imagine that you hold:

• Minimum 5 years of experience within telecom engineering, preferably with strong experience in designing and configuring industrial network systems and a solid understanding of both physical and logical network technologies.

• Knowledge of OT security standards and practices, such as the Purdue Model, IEC 62443, or similar frameworks.

• A relevant degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, Network Engineering, or a related field.

• Experience from the maritime or offshore energy industry; broader telecommunications experience is considered an advantage.

• Strong technical ownership and project mindset, with the ability to drive assigned systems forward and foster positive collaboration within project teams.

• Strong analytical and technical writing skills, combined with professional fluency in written and spoken English.

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

Apply

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.
